message.content: {"skills":[{"name":"Spider 内动态设置覆盖","description":"在 Spider 的 from_crawler 中通过 settings.set 以 spider 优先级动态写入设置，用于按传入参数定制单个 Spider 的行为；当某个 Spider 需要根据参数调整设置时使用。","prompt":"在 Spider 的 from_crawler 类方法中，先调用父类 from_crawler 获得 spider 实例，再检查传入的 kwargs 是否包含目标参数；若包含，则调用 spider.settings.set(\"SETTING_NAME\", value, priority=\"spider\") 以 spider 优先级写入设置，最后返回 spider 实例。仅对单个 Spider 特有的参数化配置使用此方式。","asset_type":"micro_skill","asset_node_id":"micro_skill_node","granularity":"micro","objective":"在 Spider 初始化时按参数覆盖指定设置","domain":"scrapy","task_family":"配置管理","method_family":"运行时设置注入","stage":"Spider 初始化","applicable_signals":["Spider 需根据传入参数调整设置","需要在 from_crawler 中按参数定制单个 Spider 行为"],"intervention_moves":["在 from_crawler 中调用 super().from_crawler(crawler, *args, **kwargs) 获取 spider 实例","检查 kwargs 中是否存在目标参数","调用 spider.settings.set 并指定 priority=\"spider\" 写入设置","返回 spider 实例"],"contraindications":["配置对所有 Spider 通用，应放入项目 settings.py","无需按参数定制的静态配置"],"triggers":["Spider 需根据传入参数调整设置","需要在 Spider 初始化阶段覆盖某个设置值","配置仅适用于单个 Spider 而非全部 Spider"],"workflow_steps":["定义或重写 Spider 的 from_crawler 类方法","调用父类 from_crawler 获得 spider 实例","判断目标参数是否在 kwargs 中","若存在，则 spider.settings.set(\"SETTING_NAME\", kwargs[\"param\"], priority=\"spider\")","返回 spider 实例"],"constraints":["必须通过父类 from_crawler 获取 spider 实例后再写入设置","写入时须显式指定 priority=\"spider\"","仅用于单个 Spider 的参数化配置"],"cautions":["通用配置不应放在 Spider 内，应放入项目 settings.py 以保持集中管理"],"output_contract":["Spider 实例上已按 spider 优先级写入的设置值"],"examples":[{"input":"Spider 的 from_crawler 收到 kwargs 中包含 some_argument","output":"spider.settings.set(\"SOME_SETTING\", kwargs[\"some_argument\"], priority=\"spider\") 后返回 spider","notes":"以 spider 优先级覆盖设置"}],"tags":["scrapy","settings","spider","from_crawler","运行时配置"],"confidence":0.65,"risk_class":"low","support_ids":["f31aad19-8430-5d68-9c9f-521cb1e6d516"],"source_draft_ids":["28b2e31f-4b13-56eb-87be-d42a8f580dcb"]}]}
